bio: Treat yourself to a delicious Afternoon Tea in Bric Bar & Kitchen, nestled inside the 4-star Hilton Nottingham.  Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or simply catching up with friends and family, the Hilton Nottingham offers a lovely environment in which to enjoy one of Britain's favourite pastimes.  Their Afternoon Tea menu features celebrated classics, including dainty finger sandwiches, tempting cakes & pastries and scones with clotted cream and jam. All of this is served alongside your choice of tea or coffee.  Just a stone's throw from the Victoria Centre, Bric Bar & Kitchen is located in the heart of Nottingham's vibrant city centre, within easy reach of the Theatre Royal and Nottingham train station.
